_comment: Maps each manuscript table/figure to the result JSON that backs it and the script that produces that JSON. 'mode' is 'auto' if a script writes the .tex directly, 'transcribed' if the .tex is hand-written from the JSON 'summary' block. All numbers are real runs; nothing is simulated.

protocol.headline_accuracy_tables: ADE20K-150 val, ORIGINAL masked-crop cache: every SAM-cacheable image of the 2000-image validation split. cache_features.py skips images where SAM returns <2 masks, so this is NOT 2000; the exact cached count was not recorded when this cache was built. The independent rebuild cached 1623 of 2000 and records that count as config.n_val in extended/mc_metrics_calib.json and rebuild_mc/metrics_calib.json.
protocol.calibration_edge_encoder_tables: five seen/novel splits, N=347 per split (recorded as config.n_val in metrics_calib.json)
protocol.dense_clip_tables: all 2000 ADE20K-150 validation images (no SAM proposer); five seen/novel splits
